name: Stairwell
desc: The view straight down an endless stairwell shaft — rectangular landings nest and pinwheel away into the dark, treads and balustrades spiralling floor after floor while a band of light wanders up and down the void and the whole shaft slowly precesses.

energy.doc: light amplitude, glow and shaft drift

scale.doc: landing size vs shaft — drives the recursion ratio (2.4 = few colossal floors, 0.35 = a deep tight nest of many)

turn.doc: rotation per floor in quarter-turns (0 = straight nest, 2 = a half-turn per flight)

x.doc: shaft centre x as canvas fraction

y.doc: shaft centre y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: board-formed concrete mass / polished terrazzo + brass grand stair / cyan schematic plan drawing (line only) / hatched engraved plate / pure chiaroscuro — form built from lit edges alone

seed.doc: deterministic seed for per-floor tone variation
